## Explicit input provenance and limitations (not news)
Subject annual data: public SEC 10-K FY2023-2025 comparative statements, as filed in FY2025 10-K; not a historical backtest. Price: Yahoo Finance Oct 9, 2026 raw daily close (USD); shares: latest SEC cover-page count dated 2026-08-28. Historical subject PE and EV/EBITDA, analyst grade/target, float, and forward PE are unavailable. Engine EV/EBITDA uses explicit DEFAULT 12x +/-3x, not observed multiples. Engine net debt=10% of modeled EV; FCF=GAAP OCF-capex, not established unlevered FCF; WACC=10%, growth=10% then5%, terminal=2.5%. Historic subject EBITDA=GAAP operating income+cash-flow D&A (AVGO includes ROU amortization); peer EBITDA is FMP-defined and not identical. Forecast EBITDA=gross profit-SG&A excludes R&D. Peer projection uses upstream one-step growth at global last-year+1; periods differ. News consists of one literal SEC 10-Q table, not comprehensive press coverage. Catalyst dates/probabilities and native sensitivity bands are upstream heuristics, not observations.
